ratification.note: BACKFILLED. This file predates ratification being a recorded act. It was classified ratified by INFERENCE — the gate observed that all four operator-declared fields were present and treated that shape as consent. Who declared these values, and when, is not recorded anywhere in this repository or its history. This block states that weak provenance explicitly rather than leaving an inference to be silently restated as a ratification. `overrides` lists the values as they already stood; `kind: backfilled` means the value was read out of the file, not declared at this ratification.

_meta.note: PATTERNS ONLY. No markup, copy, asset, SVG or shader is lifted from the reference. Every value here is a MEASUREMENT (a weight, a ratio, a pixel step) or a rule fitted to measurements. Measurements are facts about a page, not expression, and are reimplemented from scratch.

_meta.provenance_note: Derived from tenants/xago/out/stripe-benchmark.json, captured 2026-07-23 by computed-style extraction. Generation-half keys added 2026-08-13; the assertion half is unchanged from that capture.
_meta.seed_status: SEED — ratified as a schema and capture exemplar, NOT yet ratified as the design authority for this market. Stripe is payments infrastructure, adjacent to but not identical with a consumer crypto exchange. Replacing this with a properly shortlisted reference is an operator decision.

type_system.observation: Reference headlines are LIGHT weight (300/400), large, with tight leading — not bold. The hierarchy is carried by SIZE and SPACE, not by weight. This is the single largest difference from a default Tailwind build, which reaches for font-bold at every level.

card_system.observation: Squarish, uniform info cards. Small radii (4-8px), 1px pale cool borders. Not rounded pills.

shadow_system.observation: Two-layer soft shadow lifting cards off the page; never a single hard drop shadow.
